passages.text: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother’s name was Jehoaddan; she was from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah became king when he was twenty-five years old.
He ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for twenty-nine years.
His mother was Jehoaddan.
Jehoaddan was from Jerusalem.
passages.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ מָלַ֣ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָתֵ֙שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ יְהוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלָֽיִם׃

passages.text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not wholeheartedly.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah did what was right.
He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
Amaziah did not do this with a whole heart.
He did not serve God wholeheartedly.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א בְּלֵבָ֥ב שָׁלֵֽם׃

passages.text: As soon as the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, Amaziah executed the servants who had murdered his father the king.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah became strong as king.
He took firm control of the kingdom.
Some servants had killed his father, the former king.
Amaziah executed those servants.
He killed the men who murdered his father.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו וַֽיַּהֲרֹג֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדָ֔יו הַמַּכִּ֖ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: Yet he did not put their sons to death, but acted according to what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: “Fathers must not be put to death for their children, and children must not be put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sin.”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
He did not kill the sons of his father’s murderers.
He followed what is written in the Law.
This Law is in the Book of Moses.
The LORD gave this command.
He said, “Fathers must not be put to death for their children.”
He also said, “Children must not be put to death for their fathers.”
Each person must die for his own sin.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כִּ֣י כַכָּת֣וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֡ה בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹא־ יָמ֨וּתוּ אָב֤וֹת עַל־ בָּנִים֙ וּבָנִים֙ לֹא־ יָמ֣וּתוּ עַל־ אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יָמֽוּתוּ׃פ

passages.text: Then Amaziah gathered the people of Judah and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and of hundreds. And he numbered those twenty years of age or older throughout Judah and Benjamin and found 300,000 chosen men able to serve in the army, bearing the spear and shield.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
He gathered the people of Judah.
He organized them by their families.
He appointed commanders over groups of a thousand men.
He appointed commanders over groups of a hundred men.
He did this for all the people of Judah and Benjamin.
He counted all the men who were twenty years old or older.
He found 300,000 men who were chosen for battle.
These men could serve in the army.
They carried spears and shields.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֤ץ אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֣ם לְבֵית־ אָב֗וֹת לְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וּלְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת לְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ן וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֗ם לְמִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה וַיִּמְצָאֵ֗ם שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף בָּחוּר֙ יוֹצֵ֣א צָבָ֔א אֹחֵ֖ז רֹ֥מַח וְצִנָּֽה׃

passages.text: He also hired 100,000 mighty warriors from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah hired soldiers from Israel.
He chose 100,000 strong and brave men.
He paid them one hundred talents of silver.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂכֹּ֣ר מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֥אָה אֶ֛לֶף גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל בְּמֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־ כָּֽסֶף׃

passages.text: But a man of God came to him and said, “O king, do not let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel—not with any of the Ephraimites.
passages.sermon:
A man of God came to Amaziah.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
The man of God spoke to Amaziah.
He said, “King, do not let the army of Israel go with you.
The LORD is not with Israel.
The LORD is not with any of the people from Ephraim.”
passages.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַמֶּ֕לֶךְ אַל־ יָבֹ֥א עִמְּךָ֖ צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין יְהוָה֙ עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Even if you go and fight bravely in battle, God will make you stumble before the enemy, for God has power to help and power to overthrow.”
passages.sermon:
God has great power.
God can help people.
God can also cause people to fall.
If you go to battle, you may fight bravely.
But God will make you stumble before your enemy.
passages.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ בֹּ֣א אַתָּ֔ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה חֲזַ֣ק לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה יַכְשִֽׁילְךָ֤ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־ כֹּ֛חַ בֵּאלֹהִ֖ים לַעְז֥וֹר וּלְהַכְשִֽׁיל׃

passages.text: Amaziah asked the man of God, “What should I do about the hundred talents I have given to the army of Israel?” And the man of God replied, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah spoke to the man of God.
Amaziah said, “I gave one hundred talents of silver to the army of Israel.”
Amaziah asked, “What should I do about this money?”
The man of God answered Amaziah.
The man of God said, “The LORD can give you much more than this.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמַֽה־ לַּעֲשׂוֹת֙ לִמְאַ֣ת הַכִּכָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִגְד֣וּד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים יֵ֚שׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לָ֥תֶת לְךָ֖ הַרְבֵּ֥ה מִזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. And they were furious with Judah and returned home in great anger.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
He dismissed the troops from Ephraim.
These troops had come to help him.
Amaziah sent them back to their own place.
The troops from Ephraim became very angry with Judah.
They returned to their home in great anger.
passages.original: וַיַּבְדִּילֵ֣ם אֲמַצְיָ֗הוּ לְהַגְּדוּד֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ מֵֽאֶפְרַ֔יִם לָלֶ֖כֶת לִמְקוֹמָ֑ם וַיִּ֨חַר אַפָּ֤ם מְאֹד֙ בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיָּשׁ֥וּבוּ לִמְקוֹמָ֖ם בָּחֳרִי־ אָֽף׃פ

passages.text: Amaziah, however, summoned his strength and led his troops to the Valley of Salt, where he struck down 10,000 men of Seir, and the army of Judah also captured 10,000 men alive. They took them to the top of a cliff and threw them down so that all were dashed to pieces.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah became strong.
He led his people.
He went to the Valley of Salt.
Amaziah fought against the men of Seir.
He killed 10,000 men of Seir.
The army of Judah captured 10,000 men alive.
They took these men to the top of a cliff.
They threw them down from the top of the cliff.
All the men were dashed to pieces.
passages.original: וַאֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וַיִּנְהַג֙ אֶת־ עַמּ֔וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ גֵּ֣יא הַמֶּ֑לַח וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ בְּנֵי־ שֵׂעִ֖יר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃ וַעֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֜ים חַיִּ֗ים שָׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְבִיא֖וּם לְרֹ֣אשׁ הַסָּ֑לַע וַיַּשְׁלִיכ֛וּם מֵֽרֹאשׁ־ הַסֶּ֖לַע וְכֻלָּ֥ם נִבְקָֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: Meanwhile the troops that Amaziah had dismissed from battle raided the cities of Judah, from Samaria to Beth-horon. They struck down 3,000 people and carried off a great deal of plunder.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah dismissed some troops from Ephraim.
These dismissed troops did not go to battle with Amaziah.
These troops raided the cities of Judah.
They attacked from Samaria to Beth-horon.
They killed 3,000 people in Judah.
They took much plunder from these cities.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י הַגְּד֗וּד אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֤יב אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מִלֶּ֤כֶת עִמּוֹ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיִּפְשְׁטוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִשֹּׁמְר֖וֹן וְעַד־ בֵּ֣ית חוֹר֑וֹן וַיַּכּ֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖זּוּ בִּזָּ֥ה רַבָּֽה׃ס

passages.text: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as his own gods, bowed before them, and burned sacrifices to them.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah defeated the Edomites in battle.
After the battle, Amaziah returned home.
Amaziah brought back the gods of the people of Seir.
Amaziah set up these gods as his own gods.
Amaziah bowed down before these gods.
Amaziah burned sacrifices to these gods.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֨י ב֤וֹא אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵֽהַכּ֣וֹת אֶת־ אֲדוֹמִ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֗א אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֥ם ל֖וֹ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וְלִפְנֵיהֶ֥ם יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה וְלָהֶ֥ם יְקַטֵּֽר׃

passages.text: Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet, who said, “Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?”
passages.sermon:
The LORD became angry with Amaziah.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
The LORD sent a prophet to Amaziah.
The prophet spoke to Amaziah.
The prophet asked Amaziah a question.
He said, “Why did you seek the gods of this people?”
These gods could not save their own people from your power.”
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּאֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵלָיו֙ נָבִ֔יא וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ לָ֤מָּה דָרַ֙שְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת־ עַמָּ֖ם מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: While he was still speaking, the king asked, “Have we made you the counselor to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?” So the prophet stopped, but he said, “I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not heeded my advice.”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
A prophet spoke to Amaziah.
While the prophet was still speaking, Amaziah interrupted him.
Amaziah said, “Did we appoint you as the king’s counselor?”
Amaziah said, “Stop speaking.”
Amaziah said, “Why should you be struck down?”
The prophet stopped speaking.
The prophet said, “I know God has decided to destroy you.”
The prophet said, “You have done this wrong thing.”
The prophet said, “You did not listen to my advice.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בְּדַבְּר֣וֹ אֵלָ֗יו וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ הַלְיוֹעֵ֤ץ לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ נְתַנּ֔וּךָ חֲדַל־ לְךָ֖ לָ֣מָּה יַכּ֑וּךָ וַיֶּחְדַּ֣ל הַנָּבִ֗יא וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־ יָעַ֤ץ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְהַשְׁחִיתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ עָשִׂ֣יתָ זֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ לַעֲצָתִֽי׃פ

passages.text: Then Amaziah king of Judah took counsel and sent word to the king of Israel Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu. “Come, let us meet face to face,” he said.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
He took counsel.
He sent a message to Jehoash.
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoahaz was the son of Jehu.
Amaziah said to Jehoash, “Come, let us meet face to face.”
passages.original: וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶל־ יוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן־ יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לְךָ נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים׃

passages.text: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: “A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son in marriage.’ Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehoash sent a message to Amaziah.
Jehoash said, “A thistle grew in Lebanon.
The thistle sent a message to a cedar tree in Lebanon.
The thistle said, ‘Give your daughter to my son as a wife.’
A wild animal lived in Lebanon.
The wild animal passed by.
The wild animal trampled the thistle.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל־ הָאֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּלְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽה־ אֶת־ בִּתְּךָ֥ לִבְנִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽתַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן וַתִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־ הַחֽוֹחַ׃

passages.text: You have said, ‘Look, I have defeated Edom,’ and your heart has become proud and boastful. Now stay at home. Why should you stir up trouble so that you fall—you and Judah with you?”
passages.sermon:
Amaziah is the king of Judah.
Amaziah defeated Edom.
Amaziah became proud in his heart.
Jehoash is the king of Israel.
Jehoash spoke to Amaziah.
Jehoash said, “You have said, ‘Look, I have defeated Edom.’”
Jehoash said, “Your heart has become proud and boastful.”
Jehoash said, “Now stay at home.”
Jehoash said, “Why should you stir up trouble?”
Jehoash said, “If you do, you will fall.”
Jehoash said, “Judah will fall with you.”
passages.original: אָמַ֗רְתָּ הִנֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ אֱד֔וֹם וּנְשָׂאֲךָ֥ לִבְּךָ֖ לְהַכְבִּ֑יד עַתָּה֙ שְׁבָ֣ה בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ לָ֤מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּרָעָ֔ה וְנָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ אַתָּ֖ה וִיהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: But Amaziah would not listen, for this had come from God in order to deliver them into the hand of Jehoash, because they had sought the gods of Edom.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah did not listen.
God caused this to happen.
God wanted to hand Amaziah and Judah over to Jehoash, king of Israel.
Amaziah and the people of Judah had sought the gods of Edom.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ כִּ֤י מֵהָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ הִ֔יא לְמַ֖עַן תִּתָּ֣ם בְּיָ֑ד כִּ֣י דָֽרְשׁ֔וּ אֵ֖ת אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So Jehoash king of Israel advanced, and he and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth-shemesh in Judah.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Jehoash marched forward.
Amaziah also came.
They met each other face to face.
They met at Beth-shemesh.
Beth-shemesh belonged to Judah.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַאֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּבֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And Judah was routed before Israel, and every man fled to his own home.
passages.sermon:
Judah fought against Israel.
Israel defeated Judah.
The men of Judah ran away.
Each man from Judah fled to his own home.
passages.original: וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: There at Beth-shemesh, Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate—a section of four hundred cubits.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Joash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoash captured Amaziah at Beth-shemesh.
Jehoash brought Amaziah to Jerusalem.
Jehoash broke down part of the wall of Jerusalem.
He broke the wall from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate.
This section of the wall was four hundred cubits long.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן־ יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז תָּפַ֛שׂ יוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וַיְבִיאֵ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּפְרֹ֞ץ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם מִשַּׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ עַד־ שַׁ֣עַר הַפּוֹנֶ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the house of God with Obed-edom and in the treasuries of the royal palace, as well as some hostages. Then he returned to Samaria.
passages.sermon:
Jehoash was the king of Israel.
He took all the gold.
He took all the silver.
He took all the articles found in the house of God.
Obed-edom was with these articles in the house of God.
Jehoash took the treasures from the royal palace.
He also took some hostages.
Then Jehoash returned to Samaria.
passages.original: וְכָֽל־ הַזָּהָ֣ב וְהַכֶּ֡סֶף וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַ֠כֵּלִים הַנִּמְצְאִ֨ים בְּבֵית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱד֗וֹם וְאֶת־ אֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַתַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַיָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ

passages.text: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Jehoash was the son of Jehoahaz.
Jehoash was king of Israel.
Jehoash died.
Amaziah lived for fifteen years after Jehoash died.
passages.original: וַיְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־ יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Amaziah, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel?
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah was king of Judah.
The Bible records some of Amaziah’s actions.
Other actions of Amaziah are not in this passage.
These other actions happened at the beginning and at the end of his life.
Writers recorded these actions in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
You can find the rest of Amaziah’s deeds in that book.
passages.original: וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִ֑ים הֲלֹא֙ הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: From the time that Amaziah turned from following the LORD, a conspiracy was formed against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But men were sent after him to Lachish, and they killed him there.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was king of Judah.
Amaziah turned away from following the LORD.
After this, people in Jerusalem formed a conspiracy against Amaziah.
Amaziah fled from Jerusalem to Lachish.
Men were sent after Amaziah to Lachish.
They killed Amaziah in Lachish.
passages.original: וּמֵעֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁר־ סָ֤ר אֲמַצְיָ֙הוּ֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥יו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁה וַיִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַחֲרָיו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁה וַיְמִיתֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: They carried him back on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Amaziah was the king of Judah.
People carried Amaziah on horses.
They brought him to the City of Judah.
They buried Amaziah with his fathers in the City of Judah.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֖הוּ עַל־ הַסּוּסִ֑ים וַֽיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֥יר יְהוּדָֽה׃
